source_sql: SELECT NVL(name,'NA') FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT COALESCE(name,'NA') FROM emp

source_sql: SELECT sysdate FROM dual
gold_target_sql: SELECT current_timestamp

source_sql: SELECT * FROM emp WHERE rownum <= 10
gold_target_sql: SELECT * FROM emp LIMIT 10

source_sql: SELECT DECODE(g,1,'男',2,'女','未知') FROM person
gold_target_sql: SELECT CASE g WHEN 1 THEN '男' WHEN 2 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END FROM person

source_sql: SELECT e.name,d.dname FROM emp e,dept d WHERE e.dept_id=d.id(+)
gold_target_sql: SELECT e.name,d.dname FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id=d.id
gold_report_points: 逗号连接改为显式 JOIN

source_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(code,1,3) || '-' || SUBSTR(code,4) FROM acct
gold_target_sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(code FROM 1 FOR 3) || '-' || SUBSTRING(code FROM 4) FROM acct

source_sql: SELECT NVL2(commission, salary+commission, salary) AS total FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN commission IS NOT NULL THEN salary+commission ELSE salary END AS total FROM emp
gold_report_points: NVL2(a,b,c) → CASE WHEN a IS NOT NULL THEN b ELSE c END

source_sql: SELECT user FROM dual
gold_target_sql: SELECT current_user

source_sql: SELECT TRUNC(salary) FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT TRUNC(salary) FROM emp
gold_report_points: TRUNC 数值截断两端兼容

source_sql: SELECT INSTR('hello world','world') FROM dual
gold_target_sql: SELECT POSITION('world' IN 'hello world')

source_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(sysdate,'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM dual
gold_target_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD')

source_sql: SELECT * FROM emp WHERE ROWNUM <= 1
gold_target_sql: SELECT * FROM emp LIMIT 1

source_sql: SELECT INITCAP(name) FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT INITCAP(name) FROM emp

source_sql: SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(date1, date2) FROM t
gold_target_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(date1, date2)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM age(date1, date2)) FROM t
gold_report_points: MONTHS_BETWEEN → age + EXTRACT 计算月差

source_sql: SELECT ADD_MONTHS(hire_date, 6) FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT hire_date + INTERVAL '6 months' FROM emp

source_sql: SELECT e.name, d.dname FROM emp e, dept d WHERE e.dept_id = d.id(+) AND e.salary > 5000
gold_target_sql: SELECT e.name, d.dname FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.salary > 5000
gold_report_points: WHERE 条件中的过滤移到 JOIN ON 后

source_sql: SELECT LISTAGG(name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY name) FROM emp GROUP BY dept
gold_target_sql: SELECT STRING_AGG(name, ',' ORDER BY name) FROM emp GROUP BY dept
gold_report_points: WITHIN GROUP ORDER BY → STRING_AGG 的 ORDER BY 参数

source_sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.*, ROWNUM rn FROM emp e WHERE ROWNUM <= 20) WHERE rn > 10
gold_target_sql: SELECT * FROM emp LIMIT 10 OFFSET 10
gold_report_points: ROWNUM 分页子查询 → LIMIT + OFFSET

source_sql: SELECT TRUNC(date,'MONTH') FROM t
gold_target_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', date) FROM t

source_sql: SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(email,'[^@]+') FROM users
gold_target_sql: SELECT (REGEXP_MATCHES(email,'[^@]+'))[1] FROM users

source_sql: SELECT e.name FROM emp e WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dept d WHERE d.id = e.dept_id AND d.name = 'IT')
gold_target_sql: SELECT e.name FROM emp e WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dept d WHERE d.id = e.dept_id AND d.name = 'IT')

source_sql: UPDATE emp SET salary = (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = emp.dept_id) WHERE dept_id IN (SELECT id FROM dept WHERE name='IT')
gold_target_sql: UPDATE emp SET salary = (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = emp.dept_id) WHERE dept_id IN (SELECT id FROM dept WHERE name='IT')
gold_report_points: 相关子查询 UPDATE 两端兼容

source_sql: SELECT DECODE(status,1,'Active',2,'Inactive','Unknown') AS st, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY status
gold_target_sql: SELECT CASE status WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN 2 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS st, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY status

source_sql: SELECT name, LAG(salary,1,0) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY hire_date) AS prev_salary FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT name, LAG(salary,1,0) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY hire_date) AS prev_salary FROM emp
gold_report_points: LAG 窗口函数两端兼容

source_sql: SELECT name, salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rnk FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT name, salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rnk FROM emp
gold_report_points: RANK 窗口函数两端兼容

source_sql: SELECT e.name, e.salary FROM emp e WHERE e.salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id) AND e.dept_id IN (SELECT id FROM dept WHERE location='NY')
gold_target_sql: SELECT e.name, e.salary FROM emp e WHERE e.salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id) AND e.dept_id IN (SELECT id FROM dept WHERE location='NY')
gold_report_points: 多层相关子查询 + IN 子查询，两端兼容

source_sql: INSERT INTO emp_log SELECT * FROM emp WHERE hire_date < ADD_MONTHS(sysdate, -12)
gold_target_sql: INSERT INTO emp_log SELECT * FROM emp WHERE hire_date < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '12 months'

source_sql: SELECT CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF AS is_leaf, LEVEL AS lvl, name FROM emp START WITH manager_id IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR id = manager_id
gold_target_sql: WITH RECURSIVE emp_tree AS (SELECT id, name, manager_id, 0 AS lvl, false AS is_leaf FROM emp WHERE manager_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.id, e.name, e.manager_id, t.lvl+1, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM emp WHERE manager_id=e.id) FROM emp e JOIN emp_tree t ON e.manager_id = t.id) SELECT is_leaf, lvl, name FROM emp_tree
gold_report_points: CONNECT BY 层次查询 → WITH RECURSIVE 递归 CTE
CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF → EXISTS 判断叶子节点

source_sql: MERGE INTO target t USING source s ON (t.id = s.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.name = s.name WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, name) VALUES (s.id, s.name)
gold_target_sql: INSERT INTO target (id, name) SELECT id, name FROM source ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
gold_report_points: MERGE INTO → INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE

source_sql: SELECT e.name, d.dname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id) AS dept_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.dept_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS sal_rank FROM emp e, dept d WHERE e.dept_id = d.id(+) AND e.hire_date > ADD_MONTHS(sysdate, -24)
gold_target_sql: SELECT e.name, d.dname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id) AS dept_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.dept_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS sal_rank FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.hire_date > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24 months'
gold_report_points: 相关子查询 + 窗口函数组合
